# `review.resolve`

Resolve or dismiss an operator review item. Records the operator's decision; does not itself mutate any fact (use fact.correct/fact.deprecate for that).

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice review-resolve`
- **MCP tool:** `review_resolve` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | `str` | required |  |
| `status` | `str` | optional, default='RESOLVED' — one of ['RESOLVED', 'DISMISSED'] |  |
| `resolution` | `str` | optional, default='' |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice review-resolve --review-id rev_abc123
```

_Synthesized from this operation's required arguments._

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
| `invalid_status` | The status must be RESOLVED or DISMISSED. |
| `no_open_review_item` | No OPEN review item has that id. |
